count_reconciliation.table_68_difference_explained: Printed serial numbers 2001 and 2002 each label two distinct lake IDs; the two extra rows are those duplicate-serial print defects, both below the stated >=10 ha threshold (6.75 ha, 5.29 ha).

anomalies: printed serial numbers 2001/2002 duplicated on distinct lake IDs; two rows fall below the stated >=10 ha threshold
extraction.scope: Tables 68 (>=10 ha) and 69 (>=50 ha) only; not the full 28,043-lake inventory

sources.interpretation_limit: The atlas reports mapped lakes and mapping attributes. Bounded row-level extraction of the printed Tables 68 (>=10 ha) and 69 (>=50 ha) is complete and bound via the extraction artifact. This is a subset, not the full 28,043-lake inventory (>=0.25 ha). It is not an adjudicated event cohort, a complete observation history, or proof of non-events; territory must be independently resolved.
